title: Blue Mountain Beach "Bewitching Dunes" 10 N Spooky Lane
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Bewitching Dunes" 10 N Spooky Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Short walk to beach access- Private heated saltwater pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $60 per day**- Convenient location- Outdoor shower- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 5 adult bikes provided- Outdoor kitchen and entertainment space- In-home elevator- 5 parking places- Level 2 AC Charger- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: This 5-bedroom Blue Mountain home is ideal for families looking for an escape located steps from the beach and local attractions! Enter through the oversized mahogany door and enjoy the beauty of stunning hardwood floors and never-ending shiplap walls. Walk down the hall to find the first of many guest rooms, boasting a king bed and en-suite bathroom with a massive shower and double vanity. A built-in twin-over-twin bunk nook is located directly outside of this room - a perfect spot for kids or extra guests!The hardwood floors climb the staircase to the second floor of the home, drawing you into the open concept living area. The gourmet kitchen features all stainless steel top-of-the-line Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, and a massive island. This kitchen looks over the beautifully outfitted living and dining room finished with contemporary interiors. The living area expands through the double doors onto the second-floor porch, overlooking the Blue Mountain Beach community. Just down the hall, you will find the second king suite, featuring a beautifully finished bathroom and lovely pool views. A half bathroom and laundry room are also conveniently located on the second floor. The third floor is home to the impressive bunk room, presenting 3 twin-over-twin built-ins and private bath with a spacious stand-up shower. Down the hall, the gorgeous primary suite awaits you. This luxurious bedroom includes a gorgeous en suite, roomy closet, and a private porch boasting phenomenal Gulf views. The final guest bedroom can be found on this floor and includes an en-suite bath and pool views.Enjoy the enchanting back yard with its modern private pool, outdoor shower, custom grill area, and additional outdoor living space, perfect for your entire group! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Twin-over-Twin Hall Bunk BedsSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Three Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboNEARBY ATTRACTIONS: - Yoga Studio & Gym (Steps Away)- Gulf Place Restaurants and Shopping (Steps Away) - Santa Rosa Country Club and Golf Course and The Vue Restaurant (One Mile) - Longleaf Greenway Western Bike Trail (Steps Away) Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
